set.body:
Run the frozen court and determine whether reframe4s-motion actually outperforms AFNI 3dvolreg and nifreeze in both speed and accuracy. This task cannot redefine success after seeing results.

Acceptance criteria:
AC-434-01: The candidate is a clean immutable revision and every required comparator, dataset, configuration, random seed, hardware characteristic, and protocol version is recorded and verified before execution.
AC-434-02: Accuracy is adjudicated in two linked courts: an estimation court that applies every recovered transform through one common canonical resampler, and a native end-to-end court that evaluates each tool's declared production pipeline. This separates estimator quality from interpolation quality.
AC-434-03: Co-primary accuracy endpoints include physical landmark displacement p95 and corrected-image NRMSE. Exact relative rotation, framewise-displacement error, boundary NRMSE, temporal fidelity, edge preservation, ringing, and failure rate are required guardrails.
AC-434-04: Co-primary speed endpoints include matched end-to-end elapsed time and estimation-stage elapsed time. Single-thread and one predeclared practical parallel policy are run separately; process startup, NIfTI I/O, estimation, application, and reporting are also disclosed by stage.
AC-434-05: For each of 3dvolreg and nifreeze separately, superiority requires the cluster-aware confidence bound for improvement to exceed the positive, pre-registered practical margin on every co-primary speed and accuracy endpoint. Statistical significance without practical superiority is insufficient.
AC-434-06: The analysis treats subject or synthetic run as the independent unit, uses paired randomized execution and a pre-registered cluster bootstrap or equivalent repeated-measures method, controls multiplicity across co-primary endpoints, and reports effect sizes with confidence intervals.
AC-434-07: Aggregate superiority cannot hide a material scenario loss. Every required null, low, moderate, hard, nuisance, and capture-range stratum must satisfy its pre-registered non-inferiority guardrails, and failures remain part of the denominator.
AC-434-08: The claim is accepted only if speed and accuracy superiority both hold against both required comparators. Otherwise the task records exactly which endpoint or stratum failed and the epic remains unqualified; parity, mixed tradeoffs, or unavailable evidence cannot be described as outperformance.
AC-434-09: The final machine-readable decision and human report expose raw receipts, exclusions, all registered endpoints, all confidence intervals, every win or loss, and the exact permitted claim wording.
set.title: Adjudicate and publish the 3dvolreg and nifreeze superiority claim
